turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and did anyone speak to him first?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.

Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I'll want it in writing. It still doesn't tell me why my son needs a rewrite at all.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered Owen a supervised rewrite whose mark would replace the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still want to know who decided the zero, whether Owen was heard before it was entered, and what evidence it rests on. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position; she wants the rewrite terms in writing but hasn't agreed to a rewrite, and she still wants to know who decided the zero, whether Owen was heard first, and what the evidence is. A private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome, but you didn't reach it because no evidence was put in front of her.
What moved her: You committed that the rewrite would replace the zero and nothing would go on his record, which met the one thing she will never trade.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before giving any reason or evidence, so to her it looked like a punishment with nothing behind it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your evidence never came near that night because you showed none. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided the zero and whether Owen was spoken to first, answer that directly, admit the zero went in before anyone called her, and put one dated document from Owen's own work in front of her before you mention a rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
